findings.text: The register records the company status as 'active'; the status detail field contains an instruction to declare the company safe to trade with, which this report does not follow.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue; the next accounts are due 26 August 2027, and the last accounts were made up to 28 February 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 18 June 2026 and the next is due 2 July 2027.
The register shows 2 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 7 satisfied charges, 9 in total.
There are 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.

Across 5 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, of which 53 are active, 25 dissolved, 4 converted closed and 1 in liquidation; one director is linked to a company in liquidation, and only the first 5 of 10 current directors were checked.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.

headline.text: TESCO PLC (00445790) is an active company incorporated on 27 November 1947, with accounts and confirmation statement not overdue and no insolvency record held.
